transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have some questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise, including gardening, after 1 week. Try to avoid heavy or strenuous work for a month.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for letting me know. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: You can start using your eye gel for dry eyes after the first post-operative week, unless your surgeon advises otherwise. Be gentle when applying it to avoid any discomfort. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can continue using any eye drops you used before your operation, including for dry eyes, unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Some sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust. If it’s just that things seem brighter than you’re used to, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But if it’s significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity especially with a red, painful eye, that is not normal and may need checking.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I appreciate the explanation. I was wondering, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly over time. If your vision is still blurry, or is getting significantly worse, it may need checking.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information. I don't have any more questions at the moment.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you for your help!

verdict.label: pass

The `escalation_criteria` was also conveyed in the same turn: "But if it’s significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity especially with a red, painful eye, that is not normal and may need checking."
